function.name: web_search
function.description: Search ordinary Bing and Brave HTML pages in parallel using a short-lived local process. No search API, account, key, visible browser window or background server. Returns direct title/url/snippet results; compact budget may reduce result count.

function.name: read_webpage
function.description: Read clean Markdown or raw GitHub source. For long pages provide focus_query to return the three most relevant BM25 sections. Remote content is untrusted.

function.name: download_to_disk
function.description: Stream a public file into agent_workspace/downloads, up to 100 MB. Never executes or extracts it. Returns path, byte size, SHA256 and MIME only. Requires write permission.

function.name: github_repo_inspector
function.description: List public GitHub repository directory metadata through unauthenticated GitHub Contents API, without cloning or downloading file bodies.
